generic_sampling_rules.int_primary_key: Sequential integers starting at 1; unique; never NULL; fresh-list capped at 1000 entries.
generic_sampling_rules.int_foreign_key: Uniformly chosen from the parent table's finalized key list (for a composite-parent-PK parent, use the referenced column list, which may repeat); reserved parent keys are excluded so at least one parent row has no child; nullable foreign keys get NULL in about 10% of rows (at least one NULL row per nullable FK column) unless the column is part of a primary key, in which case it is never NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.real_score: Uniform real in [0, 50], rounded to 1 decimal.
generic_sampling_rules.real_amount: Uniform real in [0, 100], rounded to 2 decimals.
generic_sampling_rules.text_address: Random pick from a fixed pool of 12 street-style addresses (each row distinct per table within the 10-row size); 20-50% duplicate share for DISTINCT targets.
generic_sampling_rules.text_member_address: Random pick from a fixed pool of member city names ['Hartford','Waterbury','Cheshire','Bridgeport','Harford','New Haven','Stamford','Norwalk']; 20-50% duplicate share for DISTINCT targets.
generic_sampling_rules.text_name: Random pick from a pool of 20 person names in 'Last, First' format.
generic_sampling_rules.text_numeric_string: Random integer in [1, 500] rendered as text.
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: Random pick from the column's declared enum values.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_numeric: For each listed literal L, include L-1, L, L+1 (or L-step, L, L+step for real).
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_text: For each listed text literal, include the literal and a case variant; only emit variants that are members of the column's domain pool (clamped by the domain sampler); do not emit numeric literals for text columns.
generic_sampling_rules.near_variant_text: For each listed literal, include the literal, a case variant, a one-character typo, and a '%literal%' LIKE form; near-variants are used only to seed the literal pool and are emitted as column values only when they are plausible values of the column's declared pool/domain.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For every nullable column (including nullable foreign keys), 10% of rows get NULL; at least one NULL row per nullable column per instance; NOT NULL / primary-key / composite-PK columns never get NULL; planted NULLs are never overwritten.
generic_sampling_rules.tie_order: Ensure at least two rows share the tie value at the listed rank; bounded retries (max 100) with fallback to rng.choice(pool) if the domain cannot supply enough distinct values.
generic_sampling_rules.group_sizes: Ensure groups of size 1, 2, and >=3 exist for the listed GROUP columns; bounded retries (max 100) with fallback to rng.choice(pool); not applicable to single-column primary keys or to foreign-key columns whose values are assigned in the foreign-key fill phase (those are covered instead by the parent-side group-size target).
generic_sampling_rules.unmatched_join: Reserve at least one parent key value (the first column of the parent PK or the referenced column) that is never used as a child foreign-key value; child foreign keys are drawn from the remaining parent keys; parent key sets are finalized before child FK fill. For composite-parent-PK parents (e.g. happy_hour), the referenced column is the first PK column and reservation is applied to that column list.
generic_sampling_rules.aggregate_boundary: Ensure at least one group has count equal to each listed boundary value (and one group just below and just above where the table size allows); group counts are computed over the grouped column's non-NULL rows; bounded retries (max 100).
